scope: a dedicated constrained-QED editing task replacing the T4-labelled routing, its three wiring fixes proven at runtime, and two matched comparisons against the banked paper-era arm with units stated

authorization.reason: QED and Morgan-Tanimoto are local RDKit computations; this benchmark has no paid oracle. The currency is CPU time.

frozen_path_check.method: git diff against merge-base with main, plus untracked files

positive_control.why: a frozen-path check that saw NOTHING would also report CLEAN. This confirms the check observes real changes before concluding none of them are frozen.

what_was_built.task: src/compose_v4/tasks/qed_edit_task.py -- QedEditTask, a duck-typed peer of ProgramTask with the benchmark's own semantics
what_was_built.tests: tests/test_qed_edit_task.py -- 21 passing; three production mutations were injected and all three were caught
what_was_built.archive_top_k_is_operative_not_cosmetic: the contract's archive_top_k (8, matching the K=8 protocol) is consumed by parent_edit_search via predicted_archive_gains(k=task.top_k), so it sets the gain threshold that drives parent/edit allocation -- it is not only a summary field. ProgramTask would have supplied 10 for a pmo-kind task.
what_was_built.not_a_t4_label: kind is a DISPATCH token consumed by frozen control code, not the task identity; the direction it implies is resolved by calling the frozen guard and asserted at construction

fix_1_sa_floor_removed.claim: routing this benchmark through ProgramTask(kind='t4') imports an SA ceiling (and a 0.6 QED floor and a med-chem screen) that the GrIDDD/Jin task lacks
fix_1_sa_floor_removed.method: evaluate each panel source AGAINST ITSELF under both tasks; similarity is then exactly 1.0, so any refusal is not a similarity refusal
fix_1_sa_floor_removed.reading: the T4 gate marks the benchmark's own starting molecules ineligible

fix_1_benchmark_solving_witness.claim: a molecule that SOLVES the benchmark (QED >= target, sim >= floor) is refused as an ineligible endpoint by the T4 gate
fix_1_benchmark_solving_witness.two_independent_inherited_gates: acceptable_endpoint = feasible_endpoint (the qed_min/sa_max/delta violation) AND med_chem_gate.is_valid. A benchmark solution can be refused by either one.

fix_2_score_direction.claim: parent_edit_search.py:23 forces the direction from task.kind; a mismatched pairing inverts the objective
fix_2_score_direction.method: resolve by CALLING prepare_query_batch and observing which direction it refuses, rather than restating its expression
fix_2_score_direction.refusal_message: search parent direction disagrees with task utility

fix_3_slot_semantics.claim: PRODUCTION_MAX_ATOMS = 40 is the ACTIVE heavy-atom ceiling, not the padding width; whole_ring_plan.execute_program requires n_atoms == 48 AND 1 <= n_real_atoms <= 40

tight_from_smiles.execute_program: refused: expected an exact supported 48-slot source

padded_to_PRODUCTION_MAX_ATOMS_40.execute_program: refused: expected an exact supported 48-slot source

birth_operations_need_a_free_slot.note: a tight graph has zero free slots, so the whole atom_insert family is absent from its legal support; any support claim on a tight state is an artifact

contract_governance.claim: qed_target and similarity_floor are contract-governed and runtime-resolved, not module constants
contract_governance.missing_field_error: QedEditTask.__init__() missing 5 required positional arguments: 'qed_target', 'similarity_floor', 'fingerprint_radius', 'fingerprint_bits', and 'archive_top_k'
contract_governance.why_this_is_runtime_resolved: the SAME call path returns a different admission decision and a different task identity when only the contract file changed; nothing in the module carries the operative value

feasibility_in_support_not_reward.claim: the similarity floor constrains the SUPPORT (oracle_eligible), not the reward
feasibility_in_support_not_reward.seam: adaptive_program_optimizer.ProgramOptimizer.propose_batch applies task.endpoint_evaluator() and skips anything not 'eligible'

infeasible_probe.note: the reward is never consulted for this molecule because the support refuses it first; the earlier wiring instead admitted it and scored 0.0

evaluator_sees_program_ENDPOINTS_only.evidence: propose_batch computes endpoint = trace["endpoint"] and then calls eligibility({"smiles": endpoint}); no intermediate primitive state is ever passed to the task evaluator
evaluator_sees_program_ENDPOINTS_only.consequence: output feasibility cannot leak into intermediate program validity; a program whose last block supplies the QED gain is never refused mid-way

measured_effect.reading: the wasted budget is eliminated, not reduced, because an endpoint below the similarity floor can no longer become a candidate
measured_effect.CONFOUNDED_do_not_attribute_the_solve_ra: two things changed between the legacy run and this one: the similarity floor moved into the support, AND the proposal pool per round went from 8 to 48, so this run inspects roughly eight times as many molecules per source (326 distinct property-evaluated against a legacy proposal path that property-evaluated only what it charged). The support fix is established INDEPENDENTLY by the zero-waste measurement; the difference in solve rate is not attributable to it alone, and the two runs also cover different source sets (800 against a 50-source systematic sample).

pilot.design: systematic sample of the 800-source panel (every 16th index), run in a SHUFFLED order under a fixed seed so that any partial completion is still an unbiased subset rather than a biased prefix
pilot.why_shuffled: arm A's own rate is prefix-biased on this panel (0.620 over indices 0-49 against a global 0.559), so an index-ordered partial run would have been misleading
pilot.budget: 48 charged queries, 6 rounds, 8 queries/round, 48-candidate proposal pool

work_units_per_source.primitive_transitions_status: INFERRED -- executed endpoints times mean primitive depth of retained programs; per-attempt depth is not recorded

comparison_1_same_returned_k.question: benchmark compatibility: at the same number of RETURNED candidates, how often is the benchmark solved?
comparison_1_same_returned_k.unmatched_axis: INSPECTED WORK is not matched and differs by roughly 14.4x in arm A's favour (distinct molecules property-evaluated per source)
comparison_1_same_returned_k.unit_of_success: a source counts as solved if any RETURNED molecule has QED >= 0.9 and Tanimoto >= 0.4 to the ORIGINAL source (Morgan r=2, 2048 bits)

dedicated_task.sampling: systematic sample of the 800-source panel (every 16th index), an unbiased estimator of the panel rate; arm A's comparator is its GLOBAL measured rate because its per-source records are on the Modal volume and no local copy exists

comparison_2_same_inspected_work.question: the algorithmic question: at comparable INSPECTED WORK, how often is the benchmark solved?
comparison_2_same_inspected_work.why_this_unit: primitive transitions, endpoint evaluations, distinct molecules and CPU seconds are different quantities. Arm A reports 6,755,513 proposed TRANSITIONS and 3,761,470 UNIQUE STATES over 798 sources -- a 1.80x difference between the two units on the same run -- so the unit must be named or the comparison is meaningless.
comparison_2_same_inspected_work.unit_ambiguity_in_arm_a: arm A's 3,761,470 figure is recorded as UNIQUE STATES. Whether that de-duplicates to distinct CANONICAL MOLECULES is not established here -- the per-source records are on the Modal volume and no local copy exists, and a Modal read was not performed. If 'states' counts padded graph objects rather than canonical molecules, arm A's per-source work is OVERSTATED by the duplication factor and the work ratios below move in arm A's favour. Treat the ratio as an upper bound on arm A's inspection cost until a record is read.
comparison_2_same_inspected_work.residual_unit_asymmetry: arm A property-evaluates every state along an SMC trajectory, including intermediates; this arm property-evaluates program ENDPOINTS only. Both counts are molecules whose QED and similarity were computed, so the unit is comparable, but arm A's total includes trajectory intermediates that have no analogue here.

by_charged_budget.success: any of the top-8 by score among the first C charged endpoints satisfies QED >= 0.9 and similarity >= 0.4
by_charged_budget.caveat: POST-HOC TRUNCATION of a single budget-48 run, not a set of independent budget-C runs. Parent selection depends on the observations already made, so a genuine budget-C run would explore differently; read this as an anytime profile of THIS run, not as a budget ablation.

by_inspected_molecules.success: a benchmark-solving molecule appeared ANYWHERE in the inspected prefix
by_inspected_molecules.why_not: this is an all-sample quantity; comparing it against a baseline's returned-candidate rate is exactly the unfairness the per-sample rule forbids. It bounds what the search reached, not what it returned.

bracketing.note: NO CELL MATCHES ON BOTH AXES. These two comparisons bracket the truth.

cheaper_arm_a_point.reading: we use 0.55x the work and return 8x the candidates

equal_k_arm_a_point.reading: same returned count; we use 0.069x the work

richer_metrics.any_inspected_note: CEILING, NOT COMPARABLE to arm A's 446/800: it asks whether a solution appeared anywhere in the inspected set, which is an all-sample quantity, not a returned-candidate quantity

difficulty_structure.reading: success tracks how close the source already is to the region and how small it is. The search lands a median 0.07 short on the sources it misses, which is the signature of an under-budgeted search rather than a misdirected one -- and the charged-budget anytime curve is still rising at the budget cap.
difficulty_structure.caveat: these splits are post-hoc on 50 sources and are descriptive, not tested.

legacy_run_label.LABEL: SUPERSEDED -- produced under the MISCONFIGURED interface
what_was_wrong: the similarity floor lived in the REWARD (score = QED * indicator), so endpoints below the floor were admitted as candidates and consumed charged queries while scoring 0.0
the task was ProgramTask(kind='pmo'), a dispatch label, not a dedicated QED-editing task with contract-governed thresholds
legacy_run_label.note: the rate is reported only so the corrected run can be compared against its own predecessor; it is NOT a controller result and must not be quoted as one

the_446_of_800.value: 446 of 800 (55.75% over the full panel, 55.89% over the 798 scored)
the_446_of_800.status: MEASURED and PRESERVED -- independently re-derived by recomputing QED and Tanimoto over all 6,384 returned molecules, reproducing the whole cumulative curve [254,319,370,396,420,430,439,446]
the_446_of_800.respects_the_per_sample_rule: YES -- exactly 8 candidates exist per source and all 8 stay in the denominator; 4,301 of 6,384 slots are extinct and every one counts as a failure

the_griddd_45_1_percent.why: no PDF or programmatic extraction is present in this tree; every in-repo copy descends from one hand transcription, so their agreement is not independent corroboration
the_griddd_45_1_percent.panel_comparability: NOT PANEL-MATCHED. GrIDDD selects its own 800 by shuffling ZINC-250k with pandas random_state=42, taking the final 10% test split, and keeping the first 800 processed rows with QED in 0.70-0.80. The reconstruction has canonical_set_intersection = 1 against Jin's exact 800. Both draw from the same ZINC-250k QED-in-[0.7,0.8] population, so the comparison is POPULATION-matched, not PANEL-matched.
